scientific_estimand: Does LGM fragmentation of an insect's larval host-resource climate envelope predict present post-IBD genetic turnover beyond the present host-resource landscape?

climate_assets.lgm: CHELSA-TraCE21k V1.0 at 21 ka BP / index -190
climate_assets.reuse_reason: These global raster bytes and their byte-level bio01 semantics were frozen and audited before this historical-host program and before any fresh historical-host genetic response.
climate_assets.raster_sampling: containing raster cell; apply GDAL scale/offset only; no interpolation across nodata

climate_space.training_rows: all frozen supported-host GBIF occurrences that pass current-climate finite values, pooled across hosts
climate_space.standardization: pooled mean and population SD of current bio1,bio7,bio12,bio15
climate_space.pca: canonical-sign PCA on pooled standardized current environment
climate_space.whitening: divide PC scores by sqrt pooled eigenvalues

host_suitability.model: isotropic Gaussian kernel climatic envelope in the frozen four-axis whitened current-climate space
host_suitability.S_h_definition: mean exp(-0.5 * squared_whitened_distance / h^2) over the host's current occurrence points
host_suitability.normalization: none; do not renormalize over a geographic grid
host_suitability.reason: The insect host-union operator requires a common bounded affinity scale. The same trained kernel is evaluated at current and 21-ka climate so the scale is temporally invariant.

insect_host_union.definition: U_i(x,t) = 1 - product_h(1 - S_h(x,t)) over only the occurrence-supported accepted hosts frozen for insect i
insect_host_union.host_weights: equal through the union operator; no abundance, interaction-frequency, fossil-coverage or post-result weighting
insect_host_union.unsupported_hosts: An insect enters this stage only if it passed the prospectively frozen >=80% occurrence-host completeness gate; only occurrence-supported hosts enter U_i, exactly as frozen before palaeo exposure.

edge_exposure.graph: unchanged response-blind phylogatR density-scaled insect graph
edge_exposure.segment_rule: five equally spaced interior/geodesic points under the inherited TTF convention
edge_exposure.edge_resistance: arithmetic mean point resistance over the five frozen segment points

within_species_standardization.R_host_present: population-mean centered and population-SD scaled over all frozen edges of species i
within_species_standardization.R_host_LGM: population-mean centered and population-SD scaled over all frozen edges of species i
within_species_standardization.zero_variance: species is response-blind predictor-inadmissible and removed before panel hashing; no backfill after genetics

predictor_information_gate.timing: after occurrence-supported host union and current/LGM edge exposures, before character masks or nucleotide identity
predictor_information_gate.per_species_unique_fraction: q_i = mean residual^2 from z(R_host_LGM) ~ 1 + z(R_host_present); because z(R_host_LGM) has population variance 1, q_i = 1-r_i^2 up to numerical tolerance
predictor_information_gate.total_unique_fraction: equal-weight mean q_i across predictor-admissible insects
predictor_information_gate.species_signal_share: q_i / sum_j q_j; edge count does not weight species
predictor_information_gate.development_confirmatory_split: performed only after this response-blind predictor gate passes, using the already frozen historical-host-connectivity-panel-v0.1 namespace and 1/3 vs 2/3 rule

primary_genetic_model_if_later_authorize.response: within-species rank-standardized endpoint-safe post-IBD edge turnover
primary_genetic_model_if_later_authorize.primary_statistic: equal-weight mean beta_LGM_i across confirmatory species
